latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Editorial Highlights skill.
- Extracts key moments from raw video footage to create 1080p MP4 highlight reels.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and MKV files up to 500MB; typical processing time is 1–3 minutes.
- Automatic connection and session handling (using NEMO_TOKEN or free anon token).
- Clear workflows for upload, highlight extraction, preview, and export.
- Includes guidance on supported formats, workflow tips, and error handling.
